assumptions.note: submit time, duration, GPU request, priority and GPU model come from the Alibaba trace
the trace has no queue/start/eviction records; waits are reconstructed by simulation
a job's whole GPUs must sit on one node; fractional requests share one GPU
jobs run only on their recorded GPU model; no cross-hardware speedup data exists
worker_count ignored; gpu_request_recorded_count is the job's total request
HP jobs may evict running spot jobs; evicted work restarts from scratch (switchable to resume)
whole nodes of the observed shapes are added/removed so offered load ~ target (default 0.85); a load sweep is reported
a window starts with jobs submitted earlier and still running (assumed zero historic wait); ~5% of jobs hold ~95% of GPU-seconds
schedulers do not see true durations except the oracle baselines
no user runtime estimates exist; backfill uses oracle / noisy / pool-median estimates, reported separately

notes: Waits, starts, evictions and node placement are simulated, not observed.
job.duration_s on arrive is the service time simulated (observed duration; remaining time for carry-over jobs).
